messages:
zoe: :wave: Heads-up everyone — we've merged the docs linter + sample-sync work and released docs-tooling v0.9.0. This enforces the new code-sample schema and auto-updates SDK snippets during doc builds.
harry: what changed in the schema? brief summary pls.
zoe: Short: we replaced the old inline snippet format ("language:code") with a structured frontmatter block that includes `sdk_version`, `runtime_tags`, and an optional `compat:` field. This allows the sample-sync tool to verify snippet validity against released SDKs.
min: is this breaking for docs authors?
zoe: It will surface lint errors in CI for outdated snippets. Docs still build, but failing snippets will block PRs once we flip the strict mode in 14 days. We added an automatic migration tool and a CLI pre-commit hook to reduce friction.
docs-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1188 "docs: add snippet schema, linter, and sample-sync automation". Includes migration guide and examples.
harry: paste the pre-commit hook and migration snippet?
zoe: sure — add this to .pre-commit-config.yaml or run locally:```bash
# install the docs tooling
pip install redwood-docs-tool==0.9.0
# run quick migration on your docs directory
redwood-docs-tool migrate-snippets ./docs --backup
# add pre-commit hook to run snippet linter
redwood-docs-tool install-hook
```
min: CI impact? we'll start seeing failures in docs tests?
docs-bot: CI note: docs build job now runs `redwood-docs-tool validate --strict=${DOCS_STRICT:-0}`. Strict mode will be enabled org-wide on 14 days from today (2167771234 + 14d). Current scan: 312 docs files with legacy snippets, 78 files with mismatched sdk_version tags.
sre: any runtime/shell execution risk from the sample-sync?
zoe: No exec at build time — sample-sync only validates and replaces fenced code blocks with canonical snippets from the samples repo. It does not execute code. We sanitized all replacement paths in the tool review. Security signoff given.
pm-bot: (typo) pm-bot: Can we get a short blurb for the release notes and a recommended migration checklist for product docs owners?
zoe: Yes — suggested checklist: 1) run `redwood-docs-tool migrate-snippets ./docs` 2) add `redwood-docs-tool install-hook` to your repo 3) fix any CI lint failures and pin `sdk_version` tags where appropriate 4) opt into strict mode early to catch regressions.
harry: timeline and deprecation/removal windows?
zoe: Plan: today - release v0.9.0 and migration docs. Day 14 - enable strict linting in docs CI (non-blocking for core infra teams during the first 48h). Day 45 - strict mode becomes blocking for all repos. Day 90 - remove legacy snippet support from the docs renderer.
min: can teams opt for extra runway?
zoe: yes DM me or file a docs-infra request. We'll grant exceptions for large external guides with a concrete migration plan.
docs-bot: Added changelog entry: "docs-tool: snippet schema + linter; sample-sync automation; strict CI rollout schedule". Risk: low-medium (author friction).
harry: any sample that will be rewritten automatically? will we change API calls in samples on behalf of teams?
zoe: sample-sync will only sync canonical snippets from our samples repo (samples.redwood.ai). It will not rewrite user-authored examples unless sourced from the canonical snippet ID in frontmatter. For safety we added a dry-run mode.
min: one more ask: add a short troubleshooting FAQ if migration fails (common fix steps).
zoe: done in PR — FAQ covers common yq/python path issues, sdk_version mismatches, and pre-commit hook troubleshooting.
sre: confirm docs build job names and links so oncall can monitor rollout?
docs-bot: docs ci jobs updated: `docs-build/snippet-validate` and `docs-build/sample-sync-dryrun`. Link: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/docs-build/.. (internal).
pm-bot: (pm-bot) i'll coordinate a short internal broadcast for #eng-docs and product owners tomorrow. Anything else?
zoe: final note: if you rely on dynamically generated snippets for customer-facing guides, flag them so we can whitelist during the 14-day window. Thanks all! :rocket:
